blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We address the challenge of accurate 3D object reconstruction from multi-view images in Gaussian Splatting. Existing object-level 3DGS methods reconstruct the entire scene rather than directly optimizing the target object, even when only the target object is needed, which incurs substantial computational overhead. They also rely on 2D segmentation masks to associate Gaussians with objects, but these masks are often inconsistent across views. Such inconsistencies corrupt Gaussian optimization and produce incorrectly supervised Gaussians that degrade object reconstruction fidelity. To overcome these limitations, we propose MaRO-GS, a 3DGS framework that directly optimizes target-object Gaussians from object-masked multi-view images and remains robust to inconsistent supervision. For reliable supervision, mask-reliability view filtering excludes unreliable views. Object-supported Gaussian density control suppresses Gaussians irrelevant to the target object and prevents background densification, while Silhouette-aligned Object Loss maintains object-focused optimization. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that MaRO-GS improves PSNR, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency, with the largest PSNR gain of 2.05 dB on the small-object LERF-Mask dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们从高斯平板电脑的多视图图像来应对准确的3D对象重建的挑战. 现有的对象级3DGS方法重建了整个场景,而不是直接优化目标对象,即使仅需要目标对象,也会产生大量的计算上浮. 他们也依靠2D分块口罩将高斯人与物体联系起来,但这些口罩在各种观点中往往不一致. 这种不一致现象腐蚀了高斯优化,并产生了不正确的被监管的高斯人来贬低对象重建忠心. 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议MaRO-GS,一个3DGS框架,它直接从物体成像多视图图像中优化目标-对象高斯人,并且仍然坚固到不连贯的监督. 对于可靠的监督,遮罩可靠性视图过滤排除了不可靠的视图. 被支持的高斯密度控制压制了与目标对象无关的高斯人并阻止背景密度,而Silhouette-相通对象丢失则保持了以对象为焦点的优化. 各种数据集的广泛实验表明,MaRO-GS提高了PSNR,分块精度和计算效率,在LERF-Mask小对象数据集上PSNR的最大收益为2.05分贝.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D object reconstruction is essential for applications such as object editing [ 39 , 43 , 30 ] , AR/VR [ 37 ] , and 3D content creation [ 30 ] . Despite the importance of 3D object reconstruction, recent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 20 ] research has primarily focused on improving scene-level reconstruction quality [ 44 , 4 , 45 ] and computational efficiency [ 14 , 13 , 8 , 32 ] . To support object-centric reconstruction, several methods have extended 3DGS to enable object-level reconstruction [ 41 , 48 , 46 , 29 , 15 , 16 ] . However, as illustrated in Fig. 1 , these approaches reconstruct the entire scene before extracting the target object, which incurs unnecessary computational overhead. Furthermore, they rely on SAM [ 22 ] -generated masks that are inconsistent across views, thereby destabilizing Gaussian optimization and degrading object reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 3D对象重建对于对象编辑[39,43,30],AR/VR[37],3D内容创建[30]等应用至关重要. 尽管3D对象重建很重要,但最近3D高斯平板(3DGS)[20]的研究主要侧重于提高场景级重建质量[44,4,45]和计算效率[14,13,8,32]. 为支持以对象为中心的重建,有几种方法扩展了3DGS,使对象级重建得以[41,48,46,29,15,16]. 然而,如图1所说明的,这些方法在取出目标对象之前重建了整个场景,这就造成了不必要的计算间接费用. 此外,他们依靠各种观点不一致的SAM[22]-产生的口罩,从而破坏高斯优化和降低物体重建质量。

blocks.en:
To improve object extraction quality, recent methods propose boundary refinement strategies [ 46 , 29 , 15 ] or enforce cross-view mask consistency via tracking and voting [ 41 , 48 ] .
The former refines object boundaries to mitigate extraction artifacts, yet reconstructing the entire scene still incurs substantial computational overhead.
The latter ensures cross-view object identity consistency but does not assess individual mask reliability, so inaccurate masks are still used as supervision during optimization.
Meanwhile, Trace3D [ 35 ] identifies inconsistent masks via instance weight tracing but corrects rather than filters inaccurate masks, which allows erroneous supervision into the optimization process.
blocks.zh:
为了提高取出物体的质量,最近的方法提出了边界改进战略[46、29、15]或通过跟踪和表决执行交叉视图口罩的一致性[41、48]。
前者细化了对象边界来减轻取出文物,然而重建整个场景仍然需要大量的计算费.
后者确保了交叉视图对象的识别一致性,但不评估单个口罩的可靠性,因此在优化期间,不准确口罩仍然被作为监督.
同时,Trace3D [35]通过例重追踪识别出不一致口罩,但纠正而不是过滤出不准确口罩,这允许对优化过程的错误监督.

blocks.en:
To address these challenges, we propose MaRO-GS ( Ma sk- R obust O bject-centric G aussian S platting), a framework for direct optimization of target-object Gaussians from object-masked multi-view images under inconsistent mask supervision.
Mask-reliability view filtering establishes reliable mask supervision by identifying and excluding unreliable views during training.
Inconsistent mask supervision can also lead to unnecessary Gaussian densification around object boundaries and background regions. Object-supported Gaussian density control suppresses densification outside the target object and removes Gaussians irrelevant to the object to maintain a compact object-centric representation while improving reconstruction quality.
In addition, the silhouette-aligned object loss further constrains optimization with object-focused photometric and silhouette supervision, encouraging the reconstructed object to align with the target object silhouette.
blocks.zh:
为了应付这些挑战,我们提出MaRO-GS(Ma sk-R obust O bject-central G aussian S platting),这是在不一致的口罩监督下,从被物体遮盖的多视图图像直接优化目标对象高斯人的框架.
遮罩-可靠性视图过滤通过识别和排除培训期间的不可靠观点来建立可靠的遮罩监督.
不一致的口罩监督也会导致在物体边界和背景区域周围不必要的高斯密度. 被支持的高斯密度控制抑制了目标对象外的密度,并去除与对象无关的高斯人,以保持紧凑的以对象为中心的表现,同时提高重建质量.
此外,硅相通对象丢失还进一步制约了以对象为焦点的光度测量和硅相通监督的优化,鼓励被重建对象与目标对象的硅相通.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that MaRO-GS improves PSNR over existing methods, with the largest gain of 2.05 dB on the small-object LERF-Mask dataset [ 41 ] while directly reconstructing the target object without scene-level reconstruction. As a complementary analysis, we evaluate target object reconstruction quality from object-centric viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验表明,MaRO-GS比起现有方法改进了PSNR,在小对象LERF-Mask数据集上的最大收益为2.05 dB,同时直接重建目标对象而无需进行场景级重建. 作为补充分析,我们从以对象为中心的角度评价目标对象重建的质量。

blocks.en: • We propose MaRO-GS, a mask-robust framework for object-centric 3DGS that directly optimizes target-object Gaussians from object-masked multi-view observations under inconsistent mask supervision. • We propose mask-reliability view filtering, which stabilizes object-centric optimization by identifying and excluding unreliable views during training. • We introduce object-supported Gaussian density control, which removes Gaussians irrelevant to the target object and constrains densification for a compact, high-fidelity object representation. • We provide object-centric and mask-error robustness evaluations that complement conventional scene-level evaluation for assessing target-object reconstruction quality, particularly under small object regions and inconsistent masks.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Scene-level Reconstruction in 3DGS
blocks.zh: 2.1 3DGS的场景重建

blocks.en: Recent 3DGS [ 20 ] research has substantially improved scene-level reconstruction fidelity through enriched Gaussian representations and adaptive density control [ 28 , 21 , 42 , 4 , 44 ] . Other studies have instead focused on improving computational efficiency through pruning and compression techniques [ 9 , 10 , 14 , 12 , 34 , 13 , 31 , 32 ] . However, these scene-level 3DGS methods are designed for entire scene reconstruction and do not account for individual objects within the scene.
blocks.zh: 最近3DGS[20]研究通过丰富高斯人代表语和适应性密度控制[28,21,42,4,44],大大提高了场景层面的重建忠心. 其他研究则侧重于通过推算和压缩技术提高计算效率[9、10、14、12、34、13、31、32]。 然而,这些场景级3DGS方法是针对整个场景重建设计的,不计入场景内单个物体.

blocks.en: 2.2 Object-level Reconstruction in 3DGS
blocks.zh: 2.2 3DGS的物体级重建

blocks.en:
Several methods [ 41 , 48 , 46 , 35 , 29 ] have extended 3DGS to support object-level reconstruction. For example, ObjectGS [ 48 ] introduces object-aware anchors, COB-GS [ 46 ] and Trace3D [ 35 ] address boundary ambiguity through Gaussian refinement, and BEA-GS [ 29 ] improves object extraction via boundary and occupancy losses.
However, these methods perform scene-level Gaussian optimization prior to object extraction, which results in unnecessary computational overhead. Since scene-level reconstruction optimizes Gaussian primitives for the entire scene, Gaussians near object boundaries receive supervision from both object and background regions. As a result, ambiguous Gaussians emerge, which limits object extraction quality despite various boundary refinement strategies [ 46 , 35 , 29 ] .
Unlike these approaches, MaRO-GS directly reconstructs the target object from object-masked multi-view images and applies object-supported Gaussian density control to better constrain Gaussian optimization around the target object.
blocks.zh:
几种方法[41、48、46、35、29]扩展了3DGS,以支持对象级重建。 例如,ObjectGS[48]引入了有物体意识的锚地,COB-GS[46]和Trace3D[35]通过高斯改进解决了边界模糊问题,而BEA-GS[29]则通过边界和占用损失改进了物体提取.
然而,这些方法在取出对象前进行场景级高斯优化,导致不必要的计算间接费用. 由于场景级别重建为整个场景优化了高斯原始人,因此靠近物体边界的高斯人同时接受来自物体和背景地区的监督. 因此,出现了模棱两可的高斯人,这限制了物体提取质量,尽管有各种边界完善策略[46,35,29].
与这些方法不同,MaRO-GS直接从对象的多视图图像来重建目标对象,并应用支持对象的高斯密度控制来更好地约束高斯对象周围的优化.

blocks.en: 2.3 2D Mask Supervision in 3DGS
blocks.zh: 2.3 3D司的2D口罩监督

blocks.en:
Recent object-aware methods have leveraged 2D masks predicted by SAM [ 22 ] and lifted them into 3D representations [ 41 , 17 , 36 , 40 , 15 , 16 ] . This enables applications such as object extraction, segmentation, and scene editing in 3DGS.
Although SAM provides powerful segmentation capabilities, it produces inconsistent masks across views for the same object. These inconsistencies manifest in both object boundaries [ 46 , 35 , 29 ] and mask granularity [ 7 ] . They introduce conflicting supervision signals into the reconstruction process. As a result, object-centric Gaussian optimization becomes unreliable and reconstruction quality degrades.
To address this, Gaussian Grouping [ 41 ] and ObjectGS [ 48 ] adopt different strategies to establish cross-view mask consistency. Specifically, Gaussian Grouping employs the DEVA [ 6 ] tracker for cross-view object ID tracking, while ObjectGS uses majority voting to assign object IDs. In both cases, the focus remains on cross-view object ID consistency rather than assessing the reliability of individual 2D mask predictions. Consequently, inaccurate masks can still be used as supervision during optimization.
Trace3D [ 35 ] also addresses multi-view mask inconsistency via GIT-based instance weight tracing. However, as it is designed for multi-object segmentation within a fully reconstructed scene, its consistency enforcement operates across all objects simultaneously rather than explicitly identifying and filtering low-quality masks for a target object.
Despite their differences, these methods do not explicitly filter inconsistent masks to ensure clean supervision for object-centric reconstruction. In contrast, MaRO-GS removes unreliable views through mask-reliability view filtering and provides cleaner supervision.
blocks.zh:
最近的物体意识方法利用了SAM[22]预测的2D口罩,将其提升为3D表示 [41,17,36,40,15,16]. 这样就可以在3DGS中实现对象提取,分块化,场景编辑等应用.
虽然SAM提供了强大的分块能力,但它为同一个对象在观点上产生不一致的口罩. 这些不一致表现在两个对象边界[46、35、29]和遮盖颗粒性[7]上。 它们给重建进程带来了相互矛盾的监督信号。 因此,以物体为中心的高斯优化变得不可靠,重建质量下降.
为了解决这个问题,高斯组[41]和ObjectGS[48]采取了不同的策略来建立交叉视图遮罩一致性. 具体来说,高斯组使用DEVA[6]跟踪器进行交叉查看对象ID跟踪,而ObjectGS则使用多数投票来指定对象ID. 在这两种情况下,重点仍然是交叉视图对象ID的一致性,而不是评估单个2D口罩预测的可靠性. 因此,在优化期间,仍然可以使用不准确的口罩作为监督。
Trace3D [35] 也通过基于GIT的实例重量追踪处理多视图遮罩不一致问题. 然而,由于它是在完全重建的场景中为多对象分化而设计的,因此其一致性执行在所有物体上同时运行,而不是为目标物体明确识别并过滤出低质量口罩.
尽管它们有不同之处,这些方法并没有明确地过滤不一致的口罩,以确保对以物体为中心的重建进行清洁监督. 相形之下,MaRO-GS通过面具可靠性视图过滤来去除不可靠的视图,并提供更清洁的监管.

It then suppresses Gaussians irrelevant to the target object via (b) object-supported Gaussian density control to improve object reconstruction fidelity.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en:
We propose MaRO-GS ( Ma sk- R obust O bject-centric G aussian S platting), illustrated in Fig. 2 .
Our method first formalizes the object-centric reconstruction task ( Sec. 3.1 ). To ensure reliable optimization under imperfect mask supervision, we introduce mask-reliability view filtering , which enforces geometric consistency across training views ( Sec. 3.2 ). We further propose object-supported Gaussian density control to suppress background Gaussians and concentrate density around target objects ( Sec. 3.3 ). Finally, we design a Silhouette-aligned object loss function that prioritizes object regions during optimization ( Sec. 3.4 ). This unified design transforms conventional scene-level 3DGS into an object-centric reconstruction pipeline for robust and high-fidelity results under inconsistent mask supervision.
blocks.zh:
我们提议用图2为例,
我们的方法首先正式确定了以物体为中心的重建任务(第3.1条)。 为了确保在不完善的口罩监督下进行可靠的优化,我们引入了口罩可靠性视图过滤法(Sec. 3.2.),它使培训观点的几何一致性得到加强。 我们进一步提出由物体支持的高斯密度控制,以压制背景高斯人并集中密度围绕目标物体(第3.3条). 最后,我们设计了Silhouette相通对象丢失函数,在优化时优先确定对象区域(第3.4条)。 这种统一设计将常规场景级3DGS转变为以物体为中心进行重建的管线,以便在不一致的口罩监督下实现强而高的可靠性结果.

blocks.en: 3.1 Object-centric 3D Gaussian Splatting
blocks.zh: 3.1 以物体为中心的高斯平板

blocks.en:
We formalize object-centric 3DGS for accurate and efficient reconstruction of a target object by directly performing Gaussian optimization on object-masked observations, without reconstructing the entire scene.
Specifically, given an RGB image I I and binary object mask M M , we construct an object-masked observation: I ~ = I ⊙ M , \tilde{I}=I\odot M, (1) where ⊙ \odot denotes element-wise multiplication.
This masking operation removes irrelevant scene regions and focuses the optimization on the target object.
However, simply applying object masks is insufficient, as optimization becomes directly dependent on their quality and consistency. When masks are inaccurate or inconsistent across views, the same 3D region may be supervised as foreground in one view and background in another, which corrupts Gaussian optimization and adaptive density control. Therefore, object-centric 3DGS requires robust optimization under imperfect mask supervision, which motivates the designs in the following sections.
blocks.zh:
我们正式确定以对象为核心的3DGS,通过直接在物体质量观测上进行高斯优化来准确而高效地重建目标对象,而无需重建整个场景.
具体地说,给一个RGB图像 I和二进制对象口罩 M M,我们构建了一个对象成像的观察: I ~ = I → ⊙ M,\tilde{ I\\i\odot M, (1) 其中\\odot表示元素相乘.
这种遮掩操作去除不相干场景区域,并将优化的重点放在目标对象上.
然而,仅仅应用物体口罩是不够的,因为优化直接取决于其质量和一致性。 当口罩不准确或不同观点不一致时,同一个3D区域可能会被监督为一个视角的前地和另一个视角的背景,这腐蚀了高斯优化和适应性密度控制. 因此,以对象为中心的3DGS需要在不完善的口罩监督下进行强力优化,这激励了以下各节的设计.

blocks.en: 3.2 Mask-Reliability View Filtering
blocks.zh: 3.2 面具可靠性 查看过滤

blocks.en:
Since MaRO-GS directly optimizes an object-centric Gaussian representation from masked observations, the reliability of each object mask directly determines the quality of supervision.
However, segmentation models such as SAM [ 22 ] often produce view-dependent mask errors, including missing object regions, boundary inaccuracies, and background inclusions.
As shown in Fig. 3 , even a small number of erroneous masks can disturb Gaussian optimization and lead to rendering artifacts in multiple views.
This indicates that mask errors are not isolated 2D supervision noise, but can propagate through the shared 3D Gaussian representation.
We therefore propose mask-reliability view filtering , which identifies unreliable views and excludes them from subsequent training.
This filtering is realized through two complementary stages: Geometric view consistency and Region-based view validation .
blocks.zh:
由于MaRO-GS直接从被遮掩的观测中优化出以物体为中心的高斯人代表,每个物体掩体的可靠性直接决定了监督的质量.
然而, SAM [22]等分块模型往往产生依赖视图的遮盖错误,包括缺失的对象区域,边界不准确,以及背景包含.
如图3所显示,即使是少量出错的口罩也能扰乱高斯优化,并导致在多处视图中渲染出文物.
这表明口罩出错并不是孤立的2D监督噪声,而是可以通过共享的3D高斯代表来传播.
因此,我们提议对面具可靠性进行过滤,找出不可靠的观点,并将它们排除在随后的培训之外。
这种过滤是通过两个互补阶段实现的: 几何视图一致性和以区域为基础的视图验证 .

For a Gaussian g k g_{k} , we define its object-supported visibility weight in view v i v_{i} as 𝒱 obj k ( i ) = [ g k ∈ 𝒱 i ] ⋅ M i ( π i ( 𝐱 k ) ) ⋅ α k , \mathcal{V}_{\mathrm{obj}}^{k}(i)=\mathbf{1}\!\left[g_{k}\in\mathcal{V}_{i}\right]\cdot M_{i}\!\left(\pi_{i}(\mathbf{x}_{k})\right)\cdot\alpha_{k}, (2)

blocks.en: 3.3 Object-supported Gaussian Density Control
blocks.zh: 3.3 支持的高斯密度控制

blocks.en:
While mask-reliability view filtering improves the reliability of view-level supervision, object-centric reconstruction also requires density-level control over the Gaussian representation.
The Gaussian distribution should be allocated and maintained in regions that receive consistent target-object support across views.
Without this constraint, Gaussians near object boundaries or residual background regions can persist during optimization and may be further amplified by adaptive densification.
These unsupported Gaussians degrade object compactness and introduce residual background artifacts.
To address this issue, we propose object-supported Gaussian density control , which refines the Gaussian distribution through two complementary operations: Mask-guided Pruning and Densification and Appearance-guided Local Gaussian Merging .

blocks.en: Appearance-guided Local Gaussian Merging.
blocks.zh: 外观引导地高斯合并.

blocks.en:
While mask-guided pruning removes background artifacts, redundant and overlapping Gaussians can still accumulate on the foreground object. To improve object-centric reconstruction fidelity, we introduce an appearance-guided local Gaussian merging strategy that consolidates nearby primitives with similar appearance. For each Gaussian, neighboring primitives are identified within a spatial radius proportional to its scale.
Among these neighboring primitives, Gaussians with similar color are selected, and merging is performed when the number of candidates exceeds a predefined threshold.
The merged Gaussian replaces the group by averaging the geometric and appearance attributes—position, scale, rotation, and color—while accumulating opacity values to preserve the overall density of the region.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation of Object Boundary Quality
blocks.zh: 4.3 对物体边界质量的评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate the boundary quality of target objects on the LERF-Mask dataset.
This evaluation is conducted on images that include background regions to assess object extraction quality in the original scene context.
For existing object-level methods, we evaluate the boundaries of extracted objects.
For MaRO-GS, which directly reconstructs target objects, we evaluate the boundaries of the reconstructed objects.
Both evaluations follow the protocol of FlashSplat [ 36 ] and BEA-GS [ 29 ] . Table 2 reports quantitative comparisons in terms of mIoU and bIoU, and Fig. 5 provides qualitative comparisons of target object boundaries.
Our method achieves the best performance, with 86.24 mIoU and 83.04 bIoU, outperforming Trace3D by 2.66 and 3.36 points, respectively.
These results demonstrate that our method produces a more accurate object representation with fewer boundary errors and less background leakage.

blocks.en: 4.4 Additional Evaluation for Object-centric Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 4.4 对以物体为中心的重建的补充评价

blocks.en:
Existing 3DGS benchmarks are primarily designed for reconstruction under consistent supervision and therefore cannot adequately measure robustness under multi-view inconsistencies.
Moreover, conventional metrics may not capture perceptually meaningful visual quality differences when the target object occupies only a small image region, as shown in Fig. 7 .
To address these limitations, we conduct two additional evaluations for object-centric scenarios: (1) Robustness Evaluation under Mask Errors , which measures reconstruction robustness under varying levels of mask inconsistency, and (2) Object-centric Viewpoint Evaluation , which assesses perceptual fidelity from object-centric viewpoints.
blocks.zh:
现有的3DGS基准主要是为了在连贯一致的监督下进行重建而设计的,因此无法在多观点不一致的情况下充分衡量稳健性.
此外,如图7所示,在目标物体只占据一个小的图像区域时,常规度量可能无法捕捉到概念上有意义的视觉质量差异。
为了克服这些局限性,我们对以物体为中心的设想方案进行了另外两项评价: (1) Mask Errors 下的强性评价,该评价以不同程度的遮罩不一致度衡量重建的强性;(2)以对象为中心的Videopoint评价,该评价从以对象为中心的角度评估观念上的忠诚性.

blocks.en: Robustness Evaluation under Mask Errors.
blocks.zh: 面具错误下的强性评价.

blocks.en:
To evaluate robustness under imperfect object-mask supervision, we construct a controlled evaluation using DTU [ 18 ] .
We divide samples into Easy, Medium, and Hard groups according to the mask error ratio: at most 10%, above 10% up to 50%, and above 50%, respectively.
DTU uses EfficientViT-SAM-predicted masks without synthetic error injection, and the mask-error ratio denotes the fraction of manually identified erroneous views per scene. Further details are provided in the supplementary material. Table 3 reports quantitative results on the DTU subset.
Baseline methods degrade as mask errors become more severe, and PUP 3D-GS fails to train because all Gaussians are pruned under inconsistent inputs.
In contrast, MaRO-GS achieves the best PSNR across all difficulty levels, with 33.26 dB, 26.50 dB, and 22.88 dB on Easy, Medium, and Hard cases, respectively.
Additional DTU filtering ablations in the supplementary material show that view filtering is most effective on Medium, where corrupted and reliable views coexist, while it provides no additional gain on Hard, where most views are corrupted. As shown in Fig. 6 , MaRO-GS preserves the target object structure more reliably than competing methods even under significant segmentation noise.

相形之下,MaRO-GS在所有难度级别上都取得了最好的PSNR,分别有33.26分贝,26.50分贝和22.88分贝在Easy,Medium,和Hard case上.

blocks.en: Object-centric Viewpoint Evaluation.
blocks.zh: 以对象为中心的视图点评价.

blocks.en:
When the target object occupies only a small portion of the image, full-image metrics become insensitive to perceptually meaningful differences in the object region, as shown in Fig. 7 .
To complement the standard evaluation, we additionally evaluate objects from object-centric viewpoints, where novel views are rendered around the object.
Since the transformed viewpoints do not correspond to available ground-truth images, perceptual quality is assessed using no-reference metrics: CLIP-IQA+ [ 38 ] , MUSIQ [ 19 ] and Met3R [ 1 ] . As shown in Table 4 , our method achieves the best results across all metrics. Details of the evaluation pipeline are provided in the supplementary material.

blocks.zh: 5 读取研究

blocks.en: 5.1 Ablations on Each Module
blocks.zh: 5.1 每个模块的缺陷

blocks.en:
Table 5 presents an ablation study of the proposed components on the LERF-Mask dataset [ 41 ] . All variants in this table are trained with the proposed silhouette-aligned object loss. Applying Mask-guided Pruning and Densification (a) improves PSNR and reduces the number of Gaussians, which indicates that removing background-supported Gaussians leads to a more compact object representation. Adding appearance-guided local Gaussian merging (b) further reduces the Gaussian count and improves FPS with negligible quality degradation. With geometric view consistency (c), the model maintains comparable quality while improving supervision stability.
Finally, adding region-based view validation (d) achieves the best PSNR. Table 6 analyzes the effect of the proposed silhouette-aligned object loss. Without both, the model produces poor object extraction quality. Using only ℒ o ​ b ​ j \mathcal{L}_{obj} achieves the highest PSNR, but its mIoU and bIoU remain limited. Using only ℒ sil \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sil}} greatly improves mIoU and bIoU, confirming that silhouette supervision effectively reduces background leakage and boundary errors. Combining ℒ obj \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{obj}} and ℒ sil \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sil}} achieves the best mIoU while maintaining boundary quality.

blocks.en: 5.2 Effect of Object-supported Gaussian Density Control
blocks.zh: 5.2 支持物体的高斯密度控制的效果

blocks.en: We analyze the effect of different pruning ratios in the proposed object-supported Gaussian density control. As shown in Fig. 9 , increasing the pruning ratio significantly reduces the number of Gaussians. Moreover, PSNR consistently improves, suggesting that removing redundant background Gaussians helps the model focus on object regions. Fig. 9 visualizes the spatial distribution of Gaussian centers with and without the proposed pruning. Without pruning, a large number of Gaussians are scattered outside the target object region. With pruning, Gaussians are concentrated within the object boundary, which yields a more compact and accurate representation.
blocks.zh: 我们分析拟议对象支持的高斯密度控制中不同穿透率的影响。 如图9所显示,提高穿行率会大大减少高斯人的数量. 此外,PSNR不断改进,认为去除多余的背景高斯人有助于模型聚焦于对象区域. 图9可以直观地看到高斯中心的空间分布,无论有无拟议的穿插。 在不打磨的情况下,大量高斯人被分散在目标对象区域外. 随着穿透,高斯人被集中在物体边界内,这产生了更紧凑更准确的表示.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 限制

blocks.en: Although MaRO-GS improves robustness under inconsistent mask supervision, severe segmentation failures can still degrade reconstruction quality. The Medium and Hard DTU subsets are limited to 3 and 4 scenes, respectively, and conservative filtering achieves only 4.6% recall on Hard, so the overall Hard-case improvement cannot be attributed to view filtering alone. Filtering also depends on sufficiently localized Gaussian support during optimization. Further analyses and failure cases are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 虽然MaRO-GS在前后不一的口罩监督下改进了坚固性,但严重的分化故障仍会降低重建质量. 中和硬 DTU子集分别限于3和4场景,而保守的过滤在Hard上只实现了4.6%的回想,因此整体的硬案改进不能归因于仅取景过滤. 过滤还取决于在优化期间有足够的本地化高斯的支持. 补充材料中提供了进一步的分析和失败案例。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We present MaRO-GS for object-centric 3D Gaussian Splatting under inconsistent mask supervision. MaRO-GS combines mask-reliability view filtering with object-supported Gaussian density control to exclude unreliable supervision and suppress Gaussians irrelevant to the target object. Experiments demonstrate improved PSNR and robustness, complemented by object-centric and mask-error robustness evaluations.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍MaRO-GS 用于在不一致的口罩监督下进行以物体为中心的高斯平板化。 MaRO-GS结合了口罩-可靠性视图过滤与被支持的高斯密度控制,以排除不可靠的监管并压制与目标对象无关的高斯人. 实验表明,PSNR和稳健性得到了改进,并辅之以以物体为中心并进行口罩-过敏稳健性评价。

blocks.en: Overview
blocks.zh: 概览

blocks.en:
This supplementary material provides additional details and analyses that support the main paper. Appendix 0.A summarizes the implementation details of MaRO-GS, including the optimization settings and module-specific hyperparameters. Appendix 0.B describes the experimental protocols used throughout the paper, covering dataset configurations, mask generation and annotation procedures, object-region evaluation, boundary quality evaluation, robustness analysis under mask errors, and object-centric viewpoint evaluation. Appendix 0.C presents additional experiments and analyses, including comparisons across evaluation settings, additional ablation studies, analyses of mask-reliability view filtering and object-supported Gaussian density control, and sensitivity studies of key hyperparameters. Appendix 0.D analyzes practical challenges in object-centric reconstruction, including mask errors from automatic segmentation and artifacts caused by background removal. Appendix 0.E clarifies the relationship between MaRO-GS and closely related methods by comparing their task settings, supervision strategies, pruning mechanisms, and use of Gaussian visibility. Appendix 0.F discusses remaining limitations and representative failure cases, both for MaRO-GS and for existing baseline methods. Appendix 0.G evaluates whether MaRO-GS remains robust when masks are generated by different segmentation models. Appendix 0.H reports seed variance for the key comparisons in the main paper.

blocks.en:
We follow the default 3DGS optimization settings unless otherwise specified. All models are trained for 30K iterations with spherical harmonics degree 3. We use the default learning rates for Gaussian position, feature, opacity, scaling, and rotation parameters, and set the DSSIM weight to λ dssim = 0.2 \lambda_{\mathrm{dssim}}=0.2 . For the silhouette-aligned object loss , we set the background weight to γ = 0.01 \gamma=0.01 in all experiments.
For the proposed modules, we use the following configuration in all experiments.
Mask-reliability view filtering is enabled by default. Geometric view consistency is performed from iteration 1K to 5K at 2K-iteration intervals, using up to 20 pose-neighboring views selected by camera-center distance and the top-3 weighted similarities for each view score.
The adaptive largest-gap threshold is accepted only when the low-score cluster occupies at most 25% of the views and the cluster separation is larger than 0.5. Region-based view validation is applied once at iteration 1.8K with a hit-ratio threshold of 0.05.
For object-supported Gaussian density control , mask-guided pruning is performed at iterations 1K, 3K, and 5K with pruning coefficient k = 0.5 k=0.5 , maximum pruning threshold 0.05, and prune ratio 1.0. Appearance-guided local Gaussian merging is applied at scheduled filtering iterations during the early optimization stage. Specifically, merging is triggered when the iteration is divisible by the filtering interval and remains below the filtering end iteration. With the default setting of a filtering interval of 2K and a filtering end iteration of 5K, we use a color threshold of 0.2, a radius factor of 0.4, and a minimum group size of 3.

blocks.en:
We evaluate object extraction quality on LERF-Mask [ 41 ] following the protocols of FlashSplat [ 36 ] and BEA-GS [ 29 ] .
LERF-Mask provides rendered-view masks for object-level supervision.
For existing object-level methods, we provide the original images containing background regions as input, following the standard evaluation setting of prior object extraction methods.
This evaluation therefore assesses post-hoc object extraction quality under the conventional full-scene input setting, rather than the masked-input reconstruction setting used for object-centric rendering evaluation.
To evaluate extraction quality, occlusion-free object silhouettes are required to capture the complete geometry of each target object.
Therefore, following the mask annotation protocol of BEA-GS, we construct additional extracted-object masks for the evaluation views.
Specifically, we use Trace3D [ 35 ] outputs as visual guidance to infer the full object extent, and then manually trace and refine the final mask boundaries.
The resulting refined masks are used as the ground truth for evaluating object extraction quality.
blocks.zh:
我们根据FlashSplate [36] 和BEA-GS [29] 的协议,在LERF-Mask[41]上评价物体提取质量。
LERF-Mask为对象级监管提供渲染视图口罩.
对于已存在的对象级方法,我们提供包含背景区域的原始图像作为输入,遵循之前对象提取方法的标准评价设置.
因此,这一评价是在传统的全景输入设置下,而不是在用于以物体为中心的渲染评价的蒙蔽输入重建设置下,评估热后物体提取质量。
为了评价取出的质量,需要无闭塞的物体硅胶来捕捉每个目标物体的完整几何.
因此,按照BEA-GS的口罩注解协议,我们为评价视图建造了额外的取出物体口罩。
具体地说,我们用 Trace3D [35] 输出作为视觉指导来推断出全部对象范围,然后手动追踪并精炼出最终的口罩边界.
由此产生的精细口罩被作为地面真理来评价取出物体的质量.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics

blocks.en:
This evaluation measures whether the optimized Gaussians represent the target object while excluding surrounding background regions.
We report mean IoU (mIoU) and boundary IoU (bIoU) between the extracted object mask and the ground-truth mask.
For this extraction-quality evaluation, all methods use the same object masks and train/test split, while existing object-level methods are trained with the original RGB images following the standard full-scene input setting.

我们报告说,IoU(mIoU)和IoU(bIoU)之间的边界是取出的对象口罩和地-真实口罩。
对于这种取出质量的评价,所有方法都使用相同的对象口罩并进行列车/测试分出,而现有的对象级方法则在标准全景输入设置后用原始的RGB图像来训练.

blocks.en: 0.B.3 Robustness Evaluation under Mask Errors. (Sec 4.4.1)

blocks.en: Datasets and Mask Annotation

blocks.en:
We use DTU [ 18 ] for an additional robustness analysis under mask inconsistency.
We randomly select 28 DTU scenes for this analysis, as summarized in Table 12 , rather than choosing scenes based on specific segmentation outcomes.
For each scene, object masks are generated using EfficientViT-SAM [ 47 ] from the image captured with the highest brightness level, without synthetically injecting mask errors.
Unlike the standard rendering evaluation datasets, this analysis focuses on the effect of imperfect object masks. Fig. 14 shows representative examples of normal and erroneous mask annotations in the DTU scenes.
Normal cases include masks that accurately capture the target object while removing background regions, as shown in Fig. 14 (1-a), and masks that reasonably segment only the visible part of a partially occluded object, as shown in Fig. 14 (1-b).
We regard such occlusion-induced truncation as a normal case because the invisible part of the object cannot be reliably supervised from the corresponding view.
Erroneous cases exhibit several common types of mask inconsistency.
In Fig. 14 (2-a), the mask includes non-target regions together with the target object. In Fig. 14 (2-b), interior or boundary regions of the target object are missed, resulting in partial object truncation. In Fig. 14 (2-c), the target object is present in the image but is completely missed by the segmentation model.
In Fig. 14 (2-d), the mask includes large background regions that are unrelated to the target object. Based on these criteria, the mask error ratio is defined as the fraction of erroneous views per scene. These error patterns make DTU a suitable testbed for evaluating the robustness of object-centric reconstruction methods under realistic mask noise.
blocks.zh:
我们使用DTU [18] 在面具不一致的情况下进行额外的强性分析.
我们随机选择28个DTU场景进行这一分析,如表12所总结,而不是根据特定的分化结果选择场景.
对于每个场景来说,物体口罩都是使用"高效ViT-SAM [47]"从最高亮度水平所捕获的图像生成的,没有合成注射口罩出错.
与标准渲染评价数据集不同,这一分析侧重于不完善对象口罩的效果. 图14显示了DTU场景中正常和错误口罩说明的典型例子.
如图14(1-a)所示,正常的病例包括在去除背景区域的同时准确捕捉目标物体的口罩,以及仅合理分解部分被占用物体的可见部分的口罩,如图14(1-b)所示.
我们认为,这种隔离引起的截断是正常情况,因为从相应的角度看,物体的无形部分无法可靠地加以监督。
错误案件显示出几种常见的口罩不一致。
在图14 (2-a)中,口罩与目标对象一起包括了非目标区域. 在图14 (2-b)中,目标物体的内地或边界区域被忽略,导致部分物体截取. 在图14 (2-c)中,目标对象在图像中存在,但被分解模型所完全忽略.
在图14 (2-d)中,口罩包括了与目标对象无关的大背景区域. 根据这些标准,口罩出错比率被定义为每个场景的错误视图的分数. 这些出错模式使得DTU成为了在现实的口罩噪声下评价以物体为中心的重建方法的稳健性的适当测试台.

To generate the object-centric camera poses, we construct a spherical camera trajectory centered on the target object. Given the target object instance O O , we first compute its center C C and radius R R to determine the camera trajectory parameters. The elevation angle ranges from θ E , s ​ t ​ a ​ r ​ t = 0 ∘ \theta_{E,start}=0^{\circ} to θ E , e ​ n ​ d = 80 ∘ \theta_{E,end}=80^{\circ} , uniformly sampled with N E = 10 N_{E}=10 elevation steps, and N A = 20 N_{A}=20 azimuthal views are distributed evenly over 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} . This yields a total of N E × N A = 200 N_{E}\times N_{A}=200 camera poses arranged in a spherical orbit around the target object. For each elevation step j j and azimuthal step k k , the elevation angle θ E , j \theta_{E,j} and azimuthal angle θ A , k \theta_{A,k} are computed, and the corresponding camera-to-world transformation matrix C ​ 2 ​ W C2W is obtained via ComputePose ⁡ ( C , R , θ E , j , θ A , k ) \mathrm{ComputePose}(C,R,\theta_{E,j},\theta_{A,k}) . The resulting set of camera poses C v ​ i ​ e ​ w ​ s C_{views} defines a dense spherical trajectory that covers the target object from multiple elevations and azimuths. This trajectory enables comprehensive evaluation of the rendering quality of the reconstructed object and its cross-view consistency. Fig. 15 compares the conventional evaluation with our object-centric evaluation protocol. Our protocol places cameras on a spherical trajectory centered on the target object and enables object-focused observations.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 评价计量

blocks.en:
The object-centric viewpoints are rendered using the trained Gaussian representation without further optimization. Since the object-centric viewpoints do not correspond to the original camera poses in the dataset, no ground-truth images are available for the rendered views. Therefore, we evaluate the rendered results using the no-reference metrics described in the main paper. Specifically, we use CLIP-IQA+ and MUSIQ to assess image quality, and MEt3R to evaluate cross-view consistency, as illustrated in Fig. 13 (b).
For MEt3R, we use the default configuration with MASt3R [ 24 ] as the feature extractor, DINO [ 3 ] as the backbone, FeatUp [ 11 ] as the upsampler, and cosine distance for feature comparison. The reported score is obtained by averaging the metric values over all rendered viewpoints. blocks.en:
While the main paper reports cumulative ablations, Table 14 provides representative non-cumulative combinations to further analyze the individual and interactive effects of the proposed components.
Mask-guided pruning and densification gives the most consistent single-module improvement, increasing PSNR from 41.98 to 42.55 while reducing the number of Gaussians from 42,846 to 25,805. This shows that suppressing background-supported Gaussians is essential for forming a compact object-centric representation.
Appearance-guided local Gaussian merging mainly contributes to compactness and efficiency.
Combined with pruning, it further reduces the Gaussian count to 21,157 and achieves the highest FPS with negligible PSNR degradation.
The filtering-based modules require a reliable object-centric Gaussian support to operate effectively.
Without pruning, the object region is not yet clearly localized, so geometric view consistency and region-based view validation could incorrectly filter out useful views or regions.
This over-filtering behavior explains the weak performance of the filtering-only variants, especially the large degradation caused by region-based view validation alone.
After pruning refines the object support, these filtering modules become effective: pruning with geometric view consistency improves PSNR to 42.68, and pruning with region-based view validation achieves the highest PSNR of 43.01. The full model achieves a PSNR of 42.90 with 24,422 Gaussians. Although it does not maximize a single metric, it combines reconstruction quality, compactness, efficiency, and robustness, and is therefore used as the default configuration.

To isolate the effect of the two filtering modules under mask errors, we ablate geometric view consistency and region-based view validation on the DTU Easy, Medium, and Hard splits, with all other components fixed. Table 15 reports PSNR for each split.
Filtering is most effective on the Medium split, where corrupted and reliable views coexist, improving PSNR from 23.23 to 26.50 dB.

We evaluate the behavior of mask-reliability view filtering on the DTU Easy, Medium, and Hard splits.
Erroneous views are manually labeled according to the failure criteria in Fig. 14 , and these labels are used as ground truth for computing precision and recall.
Table 16 reports the average numbers of input, erroneous, and filtered views for each split, together with the corresponding precision and recall.
The results show high precision with relatively low recall.
This behavior reflects a conservative filtering strategy that removes only a limited subset of unreliable views.
In particular, recall decreases to 4.6% on the Hard split, where filtering becomes less effective as erroneous views dominate the input.
At the same time, the conservative strategy limits the irreversible removal of valid supervision.

blocks.en: 0.C.6 Effect of Gaussian Merging and Mask-guided Pruning
blocks.zh: 0.C.6 高斯合并和蒙面制导普鲁宁的影响

blocks.en:
We analyze the effect of Gaussian merging and mask-guided pruning during training.
Fig. 19 illustrates the evolution of the number of Gaussians over training iterations under different configurations. Fig. 19 (a) presents the results without mask-guided pruning while Gaussian merging is enabled or disabled. With the default configuration, Gaussian merging is performed at iterations 2K and 4K.
When merging is enabled, the number of Gaussians gradually decreases because nearby Gaussians are merged during optimization.
Fig. 19 (b) shows the results when mask-guided pruning is applied. Pruning is performed at iterations 1,000, 3,000, and 5,000 to remove redundant Gaussians. Pruning significantly reduces the number of Gaussians in the early training stage.
When Gaussian merging and mask-guided pruning are applied together, the model achieves the most compact representation with the smallest number of Gaussians. These results demonstrate that the two modules complement each other and enable effective Gaussian compression during training.
blocks.zh:
我们分析高斯人合并的效果 以及训练时的口罩制导穿行的效果

合并启用后,高斯人的数量会逐渐减少,因为附近的高斯人是在优化期间被合并的.
图19(b)显示了使用口罩制导后的结果。 Pruning在1000,3000和5000的迭代中进行来去除冗余高斯人. 普跑显著地减少了早期训练阶段的高斯人数量.
当高斯合并和口罩制导的穿行被一起应用时,该模型以最少的高斯人数量实现了最紧凑的表示. 这些结果表明,这两个模块相辅相成,并能在训练期间有效进行高斯压缩.

blocks.en: 0.C.7 Silhouette-aligned Object Loss
blocks.zh: 0.C.7 锡光相通物体损失

blocks.en:
We analyze the effect of the background loss weight γ \gamma , which controls the contribution of background regions during training.
When γ = 0 \gamma=0 , the model is optimized using only the masked object region, completely ignoring the background.
Although this enforces strong object-centric supervision, it can reduce training stability because surrounding scene context is not considered. Introducing a small background weight improves reconstruction stability while still emphasizing the target object.
As shown in Fig. 20 , γ = 0.01 \gamma=0.01 maintains high PSNR and low LPIPS while preserving efficient rendering time.
In contrast, when γ \gamma becomes too large ( γ = 0.1 \gamma=0.1 ), the training objective becomes dominated by background regions, which weakens the object-centric constraint and degrades reconstruction quality.
Based on these observations, we select γ = 0.01 \gamma=0.01 as the default setting since it provides the best trade-off between object-focused supervision and stable scene optimization. All evaluations in this section were conducted on an NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU.
blocks.zh:
我们分析背景减重QQ\gamma的影响,
当γ=0\gamma=0时,该模型仅使用被遮掩的对象区域来优化,完全忽略了背景.
虽然这执行强烈的以对象为中心的监督,但可以降低训练稳定性,因为周围的场景背景没有被考虑. 引入少量背景重量可以提高重建稳定性,同时仍然强调目标对象.
如图20所示,γ = 0.01\gamma=0.01保持高PSNR和低LPIPS,同时保持高效渲染时间.
相形之下,当γ\gamma变得过大(γ=0.1\gamma=0.1)时,训练目标就会被背景区域所主导,这削弱了以对象为中心的制约,并降低了重建质量.
基于这些观测结果,我们选择了γ = 0.01\gamma= 0.01作为默认设置,因为它在以对象为重点的监督与稳定的场景优化之间提供了最佳的取舍. 本节中的所有评价均以NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU进行。

blocks.en: 0.D.1 Challenges Under Inconsistent Supervision
blocks.zh: 0.D.1 在不一致的监督下的挑战

blocks.en: Table 20 : Error rate comparison across datasets
blocks.zh: 表20:各数据集误差率比较

blocks.en: As discussed in Sec. 3.1 of the main paper, object-centric Gaussian reconstruction requires accurate object region information. However, obtaining perfect segmentation masks in practice is nearly impossible. Table 20 reports the mask error rates on the Tanks and Temples and Mip-NeRF 360 datasets when masks are generated automatically with the pipeline described in Fig. 10 . The error rates range from 25% to over 80%. These results indicate that object regions are frequently masked incorrectly even under a standard automatic pipeline. When these noisy masks are directly used in 3DGS, the errors propagate throughout the optimization process and degrade rendering quality, as illustrated in Fig. 3 of the main paper.
blocks.zh: 如正文第3.1节所讨论,以对象为中心的高斯重建需要准确的对象区域信息. 然而,实际上几乎不可能获得完美的分解口罩。 表20报告坦克和庙宇以及Mip-NERF 360数据集的口罩出错率,这些口罩是用图10所述管道自动生成的。 误差率从25%到80%以上不等。 这些结果表明,即使是在标准的自动管道下,物体区域也常常被错误地掩盖。 当这些吵闹的口罩被直接用到3DGS时,错误会在整个优化过程中传播并降低渲染质量,正文图3对此作了说明.

blocks.en: 0.D.2 Background Removal Artifacts
blocks.zh: 0.D.2 背景清除

blocks.en:
When background regions are removed, conventional 3DGS still generates a large number of Gaussians in empty regions. Fig. 21 visualizes the Gaussian distributions after background masking. Although the background is removed, the baseline 3DGS reconstructs a large spatial region around the target object and produces many redundant Gaussians in the surrounding space. In contrast, our method maintains a compact Gaussian distribution that is concentrated around the target object. The presence of redundant Gaussians can also be observed in the rendered results.
As shown in the truck in Fig. 30 , objects exhibit white regions where parts of the object are partially removed or occluded. These artifacts arise from redundant Gaussians generated in surrounding empty regions.
In contrast, our method suppresses these redundant Gaussians and produces more complete object reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
当背景区域被移除后,常规3DGS仍然在空地产生出大量高斯人. 图21可视化了背景蒙面后高斯的分布. 虽然背景被去除,但基线3DGS重建了围绕目标物体的大空间区域,并在周边空间产生出许多冗余的高斯人. 相反,我们的方法保持了紧凑的高斯分布,它集中在目标对象周围. 冗余高斯人的存在,也可以在得到的结果中观察到.
如图.30中的卡车所示,物体呈现出白色区域,其中部分物体被部分取出或被占用. 这些文物出自于周边空地所出产的冗余高斯人.
相形之下,我们的方法压制了这些多余的高斯人,并产生了更完整的对象重建.

blocks.en: Table 23 summarizes the differences between ObjectGS [ 48 ] and MaRO-GS. ObjectGS performs scene-level reconstruction and leverages 2D instance masks as semantic supervision for object-level classification via one-hot ID encoding. In contrast, MaRO-GS reconstructs objects directly from object-masked multi-view images, where masks suppress background Gaussians and filter inconsistent views.

blocks.en: 0.E.2 Comparison with PUP 3D-GS
blocks.zh: 0.E.2 与PUP 3D-GS的比较

blocks.en: Table 23 compares PUP 3D-GS [ 14 ] and MaRO-GS. PUP 3D-GS focuses on compressing pretrained 3D-GS models via sensitivity-based pruning. The authors suggest that foreground Gaussians tend to be implicitly retained because they are observed across more training views. In contrast, MaRO-GS explicitly preserves the target object through mask-guided pruning for object-centric reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 表23比较了PUP 3D-GS [14] 和 MaRO-GS. PUP 3D-GS 专注于通过基于灵敏度的穿透来压缩预训的3D-GS模型. 作者提出,前地高斯人往往被隐含地保留下来,因为他们在更多的培训观点中被观察到. 相形之下,MaRO-GS则通过口罩制导回推来明确保留目标对象,用于以对象为中心的重建.

blocks.en: 0.E.3 Comparison with LongSplat
blocks.zh: 0.E.3 与长板的比较

blocks.en:
Table 23 summarizes the differences in covisibility usage between LongSplat [ 26 ] and MaRO-GS. While both methods utilize Gaussian visibility to measure view-to-view relationships, they serve fundamentally different purposes in their respective pipelines. LongSplat computes a binary IoU of visible-Gaussian sets between frame pairs, and uses it to decide which nearby frames should be jointly optimized within a visibility-adapted local window, ensuring reliable multi-view supervision during incremental pose and scene optimization.
In contrast, MaRO-GS leverages Gaussian visibility IoU across reference views as a reliability metric for view consistency. By evaluating the overlap between a target training view and its geometrically related reference views, MaRO-GS effectively discards geometrically inconsistent views that might otherwise introduce artifacts. This mechanism ensures robust object-centric reconstruction, particularly when dealing with noisy or inconsistent mask supervision that commonly arises from automated segmentation models such as SAM.
blocks.zh:
表23总结了LongSplate[26]和MaRO-GS在可视性使用上的差异. 虽然这两种方法都利用高斯能见度来衡量取景关系,但它们在各自的管道中服务于根本不同的目的. LongSplate计算出相框对相框间可视-高斯相框的二进制IoU,并用它来决定相邻的相框应在能见度适应的本地窗口内联合优化,确保在相位递增和场景优化期间进行可靠的多视图监督.
相形之下,MaRO-GS利用高斯能见度IoU跨参考视图作为观测一致性的可靠性衡量标准. MaRO-GS通过评价目标培训观点与其几何相关参考观点之间的重叠,实际上抛弃了几何不一致的观点,否则这些观点可能会引入文物。 这种机制确保了以物体为中心的强力重建,特别是在处理通常由SAM等自动分解模型产生的吵闹或不一致的口罩监督时。

blocks.en: 0.F.1 Challenging Cases and Limitations of MaRO-GS
blocks.zh: 0.F.1 质疑案件和MaRO-GS的限制

blocks.en:
Although our method achieves robust object-centric reconstruction across diverse scenes, several challenging cases remain, as illustrated in Fig. 22 – Fig. 23 .
In Fig. 22 (A), the target object overlaps with a nearby object, where thin structures (e.g., bicycle spokes) and overlapping regions are consistently merged by the segmentation masks across almost all viewpoints. Since our framework is designed to mitigate view-level inconsistent supervision, it cannot recover when incorrect supervision is consistently propagated across nearly the entire view set. Consequently, the optimization receives incorrect object supervision throughout training, resulting in the joint reconstruction of both objects.
In Fig. 22 (B)–(C), the provided object masks contain inaccurate object boundaries. Because the standard evaluation computes quantitative metrics only over the object-mask regions, visual improvements beyond the inaccurate mask boundaries are not reflected in the reported scores. As a result, MaRO-GS produces perceptually more accurate reconstructions, while the quantitative metrics remain comparable to those of the baseline methods.
In Fig. 22 (D), the target object occupies only a very small image region and is visible in only a limited number of views. Baseline methods fail to reconstruct a meaningful object structure under this setting, whereas MaRO-GS still recovers a coherent object shape. Nevertheless, this substantial qualitative gap is reflected in only a marginal difference in the quantitative scores.
blocks.zh:
尽管我们的方法在各种场景中实现了以物体为中心的有力重建,但如图22-图23所示,仍有几个具有挑战性的案件。
在图22 (A)中,目标对象与相邻对象相重叠,其中细小的结构(如自行车口音)和相重叠的区域被几乎所有观点的分化口罩相接而来. 由于我们的框架旨在减轻视线层面的不一致监督,因此,如果监督不正确,几乎在整套观点中不断传播,就无法恢复。 因此,在整个培训过程中,优化都受到错误的物体监督,导致两个物体的联合重建。
在图22(B)-(C)中,所提供的对象口罩包含不准确的对象边界. 由于标准评价只计算对象-掩体区域的定量度量,因此超出不准确口罩界限的视觉改进没有在所报道的分数中得到反映. 因此,MaRO-GS生产了视觉上更准确的重建,而量化的衡量标准仍然与基线方法的衡量标准相当。
在图22 (D)中,目标对象只占据了非常小的图像区域,并且只在有限的一些视图中可见. 基线方法无法在此设置下重建出有意义的对象结构,而MaRO-GS仍然能恢复一个连贯的对象形状. 然而,这一巨大的质量差距仅反映在数量分数的微小差异上。

blocks.en:
Fig. 23 further illustrates a failure case on the DTU Hard split (Scan 48).
The filtering module removes some erroneous views, but several unreliable views remain unfiltered.
These missed error views continue to provide incorrect supervision during optimization and cause residual artifacts in the reconstructed object.
This case reflects the limitation of conservative filtering under severe mask corruption, where not all erroneous views can be removed reliably.
blocks.zh:
图23还说明了DTU硬分拆案(Scan 48)的一个失败案例。
过滤模块会去除一些错误的视图,但若干不可靠的视图仍然未被过滤.
这些误差视图在优化过程中继续提供不正确的监督,并给被重建的物体造成残留文物.
此案反映了保守过滤在严重口罩腐败下受到的限制,在这种情况下,并非所有错误观点都可以可靠地去除.

blocks.en: These cases indicate that MaRO-GS still depends on the quality of the input segmentation masks under challenging conditions, while also highlighting limitations of the current evaluation protocol. Improving robustness to imperfect segmentation, together with more reliable object-centric datasets and evaluation protocols, remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 这些情况表明,MaRO-GS仍然取决于在挑战性条件下输入分解口罩的质量,同时也突出了当前评价协议的局限性. 提高强性,使之达到不完美的分解,加上更可靠的以对象为中心的数据集和评价协议,仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: 0.F.2 Failure Cases of Existing Methods

blocks.en: Figure 25 : Failure case of PUP 3D-GS on DTU scenes.
blocks.zh: 图25:DTU场景PUP 3D-GS故障案例.

blocks.en:
In the kitchen scene on Mip-NeRF 360 dataset, ObjectGS [ 48 ] failed to reconstruct any visible object when this scene was used as input, as shown in Fig. 25 .
ObjectGS is designed to optimize object-centric Gaussians based on object segmentation priors.
When the object region is small or ambiguous, the method may fail to initialize reliable object Gaussians, which can lead to an empty reconstruction.
PUP 3D-GS [ 14 ] showed stable behavior on Mip-NeRF 360 and LERF-Mask but exhibited a failure case on the DTU dataset. In several DTU scenes, the method pruned most Gaussians in the scene during training. Since DTU contains many views with inconsistent geometry and background clutter, the pruning strategy can incorrectly suppress Gaussians that correspond to valid object structures. This result indicates that pruning-based acceleration methods may become unstable when the importance of scene elements cannot be reliably estimated. Fig. 25 shows that even in the few scenes where training successfully completes, the reconstructed results remain inaccurate.
blocks.zh:
在Mip-NERF 360数据集的厨房场景中,ObjectGS [48] 当此场景被用作输入时未能重建出任何可见物体,如图25所示.
ObjectGS旨在基于对象分化前作优化以对象为中心的高斯人.
当对象区域小或模棱两可时,方法可能无法初始化可靠的对象高斯人,这会导致空地重建.
PUP 3D-GS [14] 在Mip-NERF 360和LERF-Mask上显示出了稳定的行为,但在DTU数据集上显示出了一出故障. 在多起 DTU 场景中,该方法在训练期间对现场的大多数高斯人进行打压. 由于 DTU 包含了许多与相容的几何和背景相混杂的观点,所以穿透策略可以错误地压制与有效对象结构相对应的高斯人. 这一结果表明,当场景元素的重要性无法可靠地估计时,以推跑为基础的加速方法可能会变得不稳定. 图25显示,即使在培训成功完成的几个场景中,重建的结果仍然不准确。

blocks.en: Appendix 0.G Robustness Across Segmentation Models
blocks.zh: 附录0.G 强力分解模型

blocks.en:
For datasets requiring generated masks in the main paper, our framework uses EfficientViT-SAM [ 47 ] as the segmentation model due to its strong segmentation quality and computational efficiency. To evaluate the robustness of MaRO-GS under different segmentation models, we additionally conduct experiments using masks generated by Mask2Former [ 5 ] and MaskDINO [ 25 ] . As shown in Fig. 26 , masks generated by Mask2Former and MaskDINO exhibit less precise object boundaries, with noticeable background leakage around thin structures such as table legs.
Fig. 27 compares the reconstruction results of MaRO-GS and baseline 3DGS under each segmentation model. Under the same input masks, baseline 3DGS produces more noticeable background artifacts, whereas MaRO-GS suppresses these artifacts more effectively across all segmentation models. These results suggest that MaRO-GS is more robust than baseline 3DGS under different segmentation models.
blocks.zh:
对于在正文中需要生成口罩的数据集,我们的框架使用"高效ViT-SAM [47]"作为分块模型,因为它具有很强的分块质量和计算效率. 为了评价MaRO-GS在不同分化模型下的稳健性,我们还利用Mask2Former[5]和MaskDINO[25]产生的口罩进行实验. 如图26所示,由Mask2Former和MaskDINO产生的口罩显示的物体界限不太精确,在桌腿等细小的结构周围有明显的背景渗出.
图27比较了每个分块模型下的MaRO-GS和基线3DGS的重建结果. 在同样的输入口罩下,基线3DGS生产出更显著的背景文物,而MaRO-GS则在所有分块模型中更有效地压制了这些文物. 这些结果表明,在不同的分解模型下,MaRO-GS比基线3DGS更坚固.

blocks.en: Appendix 0.H Seed Variance
blocks.zh: 附录0.H 种子差异

blocks.en:
We repeat the key comparisons over three random seeds to assess run-to-run variation, and report the mean and standard deviation in Tables 24 and 25 .
For LERF-Mask and Mip-NeRF 360, we compare MaRO-GS with FDS-GS, which has the strongest competing PSNR in Table 1 of the main paper.
For Tanks and Temples, we report all methods because the PSNR margins among the compared methods are relatively small.
For DTU, we compare MaRO-GS with ObjectGS, which has the strongest competing PSNR across the Easy, Medium, and Hard splits in Table 3 of the main paper.
blocks.zh:
我们重复三个随机种子的关键比较,以评估运行中的变化,并在表24和表25中报告平均差和标准差。
对于LERF-Mask和Mip-NERF 360,我们比较了MaRO-GS与FDS-GS,后者在主要论文表1中具有最强的相竞争PSNR.
就坦克和庙宇而言,我们报告所有方法,因为比较方法中的PSNR幅度相对较小。
对于DTU,我们比较了MaRO-GS和ObjectGS,在主论文表3中,ObjectGS在Easy,Medium和Hard相撞的PSNR最强.

blocks.en:

For each reported setting, the mean PSNR margin between MaRO-GS and the strongest competing method is larger than the PSNR standard deviation of either method.
